title: Boss: Job Runner
summary: Promises, async/await, parallel limits, timeouts and error handling together.

steps.title: The job
steps.body: A background job runner takes a list of async jobs and runs them with care: some jobs fail, some are slow, and the server can only handle a few at a time. Delays in the tests are a few milliseconds; slow losers are 2 seconds and are never waited for.
